title: Buff eight low-win-rate cards
notes: Issue #1194 buffs eight cards with low win rates, on both faces: #76 Field of Dreams costs (2), was (3); C+ #64 Mulch Muncher (5), was (10), its Fruit discount kept; Meditative #19.1 Temporal Rift (0), was (2); Meditative #80 Aluneth's three end-of-turn draws each cost (1) less (a new discount param); C #64 Malzahar's Recycler discards its 2 random cards on a once-a-turn Activate, paid as its cost, in place of its end of turn; C+ #33 Ivory Tower gains Aura: Your Units have Flying and Stack., which reaches its controller's Units in hand (R1194000); Meditative #75 Ever Growing Tree Discovers 1 of 3 Field Spells, was 1 of 2; Meditative #54 Money Machine is reworked: at end of turn one The Coin into the opponent's deck, and a controller-only Activate shuffles a The Coin (Radiant on the Radiant face) into your deck, with no roll, price or Tribute. Five of them were already claimed by a pending patch when this one was written, and a card ships in one patch, so their changes ship under that patch's claim: classic-064, meditative-019-1, meditative-054 and meditative-080 under v0.3.8 and meditative-075 under v0.3.10. This note's player lines still describe them. Four scripts are kept for v0.3.7b's replays (R767000): the Recycler's, Ivory Tower's, Money Machine's and Aluneth's.

player.title: Eight cards buffed
balance: Field of Dreams costs (2), down from (3).
Mulch Muncher costs (5), down from (10). Each Fruit you've played still makes it cost (1) less.
Aluneth: the 3 cards it draws at the end of your turn each cost (1) less.
changes: Malzahar's Recycler discards its 2 random cards when you Activate it, once a turn, instead of at the end of your turn, and still draws for them.
Ivory Tower: Aura: Your Units have Flying and Stack, in your hand as on the field, so they can be played onto an occupied zone or into an empty backrow zone.
Ever Growing Tree: its Activate Discovers a Field Spell to fuse into it, a choice of 3 where it was 2.
Money Machine: at the end of your turn it shuffles a The Coin into your opponent's deck, and nothing into yours.
Money Machine: its Activate, once a turn and yours alone, shuffles a The Coin into your deck (Radiant: a Radiant one). It no longer costs mana or Tributes it, and your opponent can't use it.
